title: mezobromelia capituligera
intro: Mezobromelia capituligera, commonly known as the 'Red Plumeria', is a species of flowering plant in the bromeliad family. It is primarily used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The plant is reported to possess therapeutic actions such as analgesic, antispasmodic, and expectorant effects, making it useful in treating various ailments. Bioactive constituents present in Mezobromelia capituligera include flavonoids, phenolic compounds, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
